author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 17.1: Lineage Synthesis (Validity Fix)
abstract:
This is a resubmission of Experiment 17, which failed due to a floating-point precision error.
The bug was a missing final call to the `_ensure_validity` function on the best packing found.
This version corrects the omission, ensuring the returned packing is sanitized.
The experiment's core hypothesis remains: testing if a Voronoi-selected seed can be refined to a new SOTA using the lineage's best "push-pull" technique.
